chat.t: [Notice: Midwen Corporation Secretariat Special Recruitment Temporary Intern Interview]

Time: Tomorrow at 1:00 PM
Location: Midwen Corporation Headquarters

o: I never applied for a job.

chat.t: I know. Think of it as a form of headhunting.
Whether you accept or decline is entirely up to you.

o: Isn't that a pretty big company?

chat.t: Pretty big'?
How offensive. Our enterprise is not just 'pretty big'

o: Oh, so the pay is good too?

chat.t: You state the obvious.
We never neglect our employees, even if they are interns.
As long as you have the ability, you can easily become a full-time employee.
That is what Midwen Corporation is all about.

o: Alright, why not give it a shot?

chat.t: If you are interested, please do not be late.
Because every single second of my time is precious.
Following our internal review, we have decided to accept your application.

o: You certainly have an eye for talent.
But it's a bit surprising that I passed with an interview like this.

chat.t: We cannot afford to lose a talented individual, even if they are a bit eccentric.
It was helpful in terms of understanding what kind of person you are.

o: Well, if you say so, Director.

chat.t: The person in charge will contact you regarding the required documents and future schedule.
I know you are a free-spirited person, but I expect you to follow at least that much.

o: If that's what you want, I'll do it with my eyes closed.

chat.t: I will see you on your first day of work then.

lines.t: In Front of Midwen Corporation

You're here.
I'm impressed you arrived on time.
Just how low were your expectations of me?
It's not just you.
Every evaluation must start from zero.
That is how we minimize making incorrect judgments.
Ah, is that why the Director came out in person?
The staff are busy, so I simply stepped out since I had a moment.
I don't really like companies that overwork their employees like that.
If you don't like it, you can leave.
But you know, being told not to do something only makes me want to do it more.
Now, guide me inside.

You have quite the spirit.
The interior is very spacious, so follow me closely so you don't get lost.
Midwen Corporation Creative Strategy Office
Oh, the view is pretty nice.

Have a seat.
We will begin the interview immediately.
How unromantic.
First, please introduce yourself.
You guys are the ones who wanted me, aren't you?
So you should be the ones introducing yourselves first.
Do I need to explain what an interview is first?
I know exactly what an interview is.
Then what on earth is this attitude?
I have the right to know who Midwen is too.
So, use this opportunity to tell me about yourself.
That way, we can figure out if we're a good fit for each other.
I can see you are someone who is shameless and confident no matter the situation.
Then let us have a relaxed conversation.
Good, now you're talking.
Then let's start with your introduction.
I am Midwen, the Director and CEO of Midwen Corporation.
I manage the overall operations of the company, and you will be working as my secretary.
No, that's not what I wanted.
Pardon?
Your height?
Your three sizes?
What color are your panties today?
W-Why on earth would you ask that in an interview?!
Hey, you never know.
You might get completely soaked out of nowhere, and I might have to buy you clothes.
This is information to prepare for those situations.
I would never make my secretary do something like that!
Really? That's a shame.
And here I was thinking we'd have some private office moments together, Director.
We will be alone, but nothing like what you are imagining will happen.
At any rate, I understand what it is you want perfectly.
Let's share our honest thoughts with each other.
Because it seems difficult to properly evaluate you through a conventional interview.
Now we're talking.
Then get ready to spill everything.

chat.t: I've reviewed all the documents.
There are a few things that concern me, but...
I'll let those slide under my authority.

o: Must be nice being the CEO.

chat.t: It is the result of all my hard work.
More importantly, you do know that tomorrow is your first day, right?

o: There's no way I'd forget the day I start with you.

chat.t: That sounds strangely suggestive.
Please meet me at the main entrance on time.
Since you don't have an employee badge yet, let's head in together.
She is on vacation.
Since I am her direct supervisor, I suppose that makes me your mentor.

o: Where in the world is a conglomerate CEO anyone's mentor?

chat.t: You said you disliked conventional thinking. It's certainly possible.
Anyway, please don't be late tomorrow. You know the reason, right?

o: Because every second of your time is precious?

chat.t: You remember well.
Do you remember what you learned today?
Sigh... I figured as much.
That's why I told you to take notes.
From my perspective, you seem rather stupid.

o: More importantly, the workload is the real issue!
How can a secretary have so much work!

chat.t: As my secretary, that's only natural.

o: Even the world's greatest genius couldn't memorize all that.

chat.t: Then you can just become the world's greatest genius.
I've prepared something for someone like you.
Midwen sent you a file.
It was written by the mentor you were looking so desperately for yesterday.
She stayed up all night crying her eyes out to write it before leaving for vacation.
Please make sure you familiarize yourself with it completely before coming in.
Fumbling like you did today will only hinder our work.

lines.t: In Front of Midwen Corporation
Midwen, wake up!
Wake up! Wake up!
Midwen Corporation, compensate us for the damage caused by your business!
Compensate! Compensate!
Whoa... What is all this chaos?
You've arrived right on time.
You've got a lot of sins on your head, don't you?
When running a business, there are things you must carry.

My image, the influence of the enterprise, the employees who follow me,
and criticisms and rumors like these.
Where there's smoke, there's fire, right?
If there is any fault, it would be my outstanding business capabilities.
For those people are the CEOs of companies that went bankrupt while competing with me.
A lot of free time, huh?
Indeed.
No, I mean you.
Pardon?
How long are you going to just watch them run wild?
Well, as long as they don't cause any direct harm to us, it's fine.
I see...
Hey, losers!
What? Losers?
If you got utterly crushed by our CEO, you should stay on your knees instead of crawling out here!
Midwen ruined us using unfair methods!
Now that you mention it, how did you win?
I made them fight each other and took over the market in the meantime.
Well, no wonder they're bitter.
Whose side are you on anyway?
Yours, of course.

If not for that incident...
it wouldn't have turned out like this!
No, if you guys actually did a good job, you wouldn't have gone bankrupt.
Regardless of the method, Midwen is the one who took the market in the end.
If you had come to your senses sooner and cooperated, you wouldn't have ended up on the streets.
So, you're saying we should have just taken the market by any means necessary?
Like, say, while the CEO is hospitalized in SOS from some unfortunate accident.
You heard that?
Now it's self-defense, right?

Sigh...
Did you put on this act just to draw those words out of them?
Hurry up and protect your image, the company behind you, and your employee—me.
I'm reluctant to act according to your wishes, but I must seize the opportunity.
Ugh...
It certainly is refreshing to handle it like this.
It's always best to pull a bad tooth.
Only this once, though.
If this keeps happening, rumors like this will start spreading.
That Midwen used brute force to crush competitor CEOs and take over the market.
So what?
Business is all about image, after all.
Once that kind of image is established, no one will want to do business with us.
A day or two might be fine, but if we end up isolated, we won't be able to do anything.
Just like them, you mean?

Indeed.
Your understanding is quite impressive.
Well, you explained it well.
Let's go with that.
More importantly, why did you set the stage and then step back alone?
Take a good look at me.
I don't have a weapon, do I?
Sigh... I should have known.
I was a fool to expect you to fight barehanded.
Shall we head inside and finalize the hiring process?
I was waiting for those exact words.

chat.t: Have you gotten a bit more used to the work?
It's a relief to see you still have the energy to reply.
We have a sudden out-of-office schedule tomorrow.
Please report to work here.
Midwen shared a location.
Of course, you'll be compensated for it.

o: Sigh... guess I'll have to go...

chat.t: Then please make sure you aren't late.
I'm done checking on my end.
Let's meet at that bus stop from earlier.

o: I'll pretend to be asleep again.

chat.t: Of course not.
I've called my car, so let's ride together.
There is rain in the forecast.
So please come rest at my place.

lines.t: Outskirts
You made it just in the nick of time.
This is the middle of nowhere.
I spent a fortune on the taxi fare.
For now, that is.
How we develop this place from now on is up to us.
Then public transport will become more convenient too.
Why did you buy land like this?
Because it wasn't always like this.
Is it like a decaying town?

Yes, that's right.
Since it is quite far from the city center.
The population dwindled, the buses stopped running, and eventually, everyone left.
And the landowner opposed development because of old memories.
So you've come to trample over those memories.
That's one more bad rumor to add to your list.
Your choice of words is always so...
I'm trying to help them be able to live on this land again.
First, take this.
What is this?
It is the list we will check together.
So, a plan for our future, so to speak.
That's not wrong.
So let's make sure we check off everything.
But isn't it getting darker?
Now that you mention it...
It looks like it's going to pour.
Shhhhhhh—!
Let's take shelter from the rain first!
To that bus stop over there...!

Phew... I'm completely soaked.
Oof.
W-Why... why are you taking off your clothes?!
If I don't take them off, I'll catch a cold, you know?
That might be true, but...
Then I won't be able to work anyway, so I might as well take a nap.
Can I sleep?
Honestly, do whatever you want!
Only until the rain stops!
You... you're awake, aren't you?
How did you know?
Why did you suddenly pucker your lips?
I thought it was that kind of moment, was I a bit too early?
Honestly...
More importantly, I think the shower has passed.
Wow, the countryside air after the rain is so fresh, it feels great!
Since when?
Doing what?
Don't tell me you weren't sleeping from the very beginning?
Shall we keep that as a secret between you and me?

Goodness...
So this is what it feels like when the pet dog bites its master.

So what?
At least you feel better after pouring your heart out.
Let's finish up work quickly and go back.
And you usually have no motivation!

chat.t: Where are you?
The car has already arrived.
Let's head back quickly before it gets cold.
Did you get back safely?

o: I got caught by the police.

chat.t: What? Where are you?

o: I safely arrived at the Hideout.

chat.t: Honestly, you...
Don't speak as if we're having a casual fling.

o: Going to work isn't just about the money, after all.

chat.t: What? What does that mean?
Why do you always trail off on such important things?!

lines.t: High-End Residential Area
I never expected to come to a place like this.
Most people wouldn't have any reason to come here.
Since you might get arrested just for loitering.
That's a bit harsh.
Anyway, this way.
Let's head inside before the rain gets heavy again.
Midwen's House
So this is a rich person's house...
The Hideout doesn't even compare to this.
Of course.
I don't know where you live, but trying to compare them is a mistake.
How much is this, by the way?

It's a secret.
It would sound like bragging if I told you.
Actually, I don't need a house this big.
I just needed a home with good security where I could rest in peace.
So you mean you want to rest in peace with me, right?
W-What on earth are you talking about?!
Are you going to bite your master again?
If you want me to.
With pleasure.
Stop talking nonsense and go take a shower.
Since I'll be taking one too.
Midwen's House
I know you like playing pranks, but...
I'm a bit exhausted today.
But inviting me to your house means there's a reason, right?
Is it really okay for me to go back?
Ngh...
Haven't you been waiting for a day like this?
No, I haven't.
Don't try to hide your feelings so much.
Just think of me as your pet dog.
Because I'll bark for you if you want.
What on earth does that mean?
There are things you can say to a dog that you can't say to a human, right?
Just speak comfortably.
You must seize the opportunity when it comes.
Sigh... you're right.
Then play along with me until the very end.
That's exactly what I came for.

chat.t: Today is the last day.
You won't have anything special to do today.
So you can report to work as usual and leave on time.
Since it's your last day.
That is not allowed.
Anyway, please make sure you aren't late.
Thank you for your hard work until the very last day.
When working, sometimes it gets past midnight.
So you're saying you're no longer an employee?

o: Of course. The contract binding you and me is over after midnight!

chat.t: Then, will you be ending our relationship as well?

o: I never let go of a fish I've already caught.

chat.t: Very well, then please contact me occasionally.

o: Can I contact you when I need money?

chat.t: Only if you intend to work properly.

lines.t: Midwen Corporation Creative Strategy Office
Today is the last time I'll see this nice view.
If you're going to miss it, you could always work a bit longer.
But the contract ends today, doesn't it?
We can simply sign a new contract.
I've already prepared one.
What do you say?
Forget about that.
I'm ending it here.
I knew you would say that.
You wasted your effort.
It wasn't a wasted effort.
It is foolish to give up without even trying when it costs neither time nor money.
Now, let's discuss our next topic.
You're trying to milk me dry until the very end.

This isn't about work.
It's a business deal of sorts.
What will it take to get you to work under me?
You haven't given up?
Not yet.
Working with you made me realize something.
Being under someone just isn't my style.
So, you should work under me instead.
Excuse me? Me?
Why on earth would I need to work under you?
I'm the owner of a major corporation in Humanitas.
What if I become higher-ranking than you?
For example?
Like, conquering Edea.
You always say the most ridiculous things.
Though, working under the conqueror of Edea doesn't sound too bad.
Of course.
Since I hate working, I'll dump all the work on you.

Very well.
If that day ever comes, be sure to find me.
But first, you must finish today's tasks, correct?

Shoot.
And here I was trying to sneak away.
I can see right through all your schemes now.
Hurry up and wrap up the remaining work, then write the handover document.
If you're late, it's overtime.
Even a handover document?
You said my mentor stayed up all night writing one!
Don't worry, I'll stay by your side.
Well, that's not so bad...
Now, let's get to work together.
